sql: select s.relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(s.relid)) as total_size, s.n_live_tup, s.seq_scan, s.seq_tup_read, s.idx_scan, s.n_tup_ins, s.n_tup_upd, s.n_tup_del, io.heap_blks_read, io.heap_blks_hit, io.idx_blks_read, s.last_autovacuum from pg_stat_user_tables s join pg_statio_user_tables io using (relid) order by coalesce(io.heap_blks_read,0)+coalesce(io.idx_blks_read,0) desc limit 30
